claim: Supported persistent effort defaults were aligned with the user's quality preference: native Codex now saves ultra, matching Desktop; Claude saves xhigh. Native config/read returned ultra for both Codex homes with the selected project's layers. A short acceptance and independent-review rule is saved in all three global instruction files.
limitations: Configuration and schema acceptance only; no model turn, comparative quality benchmark, token-saving or full workflow E2E claim.
Saved defaults apply to fresh sessions; already-open sessions may retain their earlier effort. Native workers can resolve effort differently through roles and overrides.
Claude max is available as a session option, not a valid persisted effortLevel. Adaptive thinking stays at its native enabled default.
Claude doctor retains the known intentional whitespace warning for query/document embedding prefixes. No other configuration was changed to suppress it.
The official SDK config/read observer is a local integration that selects safe fields. It is not an upstream test suite and does not execute a model task.

desktop_codex.preservation_basis: No Desktop config edit was performed. Current values were read back; no before-copy was retained for independent byte comparison.

codex_effective_configuration.projection: Exact stdout of the local SDK observer; it selects only scope, method, model and effort from actual native responses. Original private home/project paths are not printed.

claude_acceptance.remaining_diagnostic: Existing intentional whitespace in EMBEDDING_QUERY_PREFIX and EMBEDDING_DOCUMENT_PREFIX.

instruction_accounting.scope: Exact local instruction artifacts; not provider consumption or savings.
